# Code Generation

A document, called **Using an LLM to Create R Code** ([read it here](https://kimbridges-documents.netlify.app/using_an_llm/)), was created to show how simple statements in English can create R code that will input and analyze data. The target audience is researchers in the general field of ethnobiology, although the technology applies to a much wider field of science.
